raw: “I’d probably send them to my usual grocery store, at 24 Birch Road. You head east from my home along Canal Street, then turn right onto Birch Road at the florist. The florist is the thing I’d tell them to look for—it’s easier to picture a shop than just remember a street name. Shops make me think of work, although I work at an aquarium shop, so that’s a different sort of shop. Anyway, Birch Road, number 24. That’s where the grocery store is.”
